subject: Standardized Root Mean Square Residual in multigroup analyses

messages.author: 7cda6162efe57d86
messages.subject: Standardized Root Mean Square Residual in multigroup analyses
parts:
Hello,

It has been my understanding that you ought to get an RMR/SRMR for each group in a multi-group analysis; however, I only get one when I estimate a multigroup model using lavaan.

Can anyone let me know whether there is either a) a utility to estimate SRMR for each group or b) whether the SRMR really is as simple as taking the arithmetic mean of the standardized residuals for the elements in the standardized residual matrix?

Thank you!

MAM

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Standardized Root Mean Square Residual in multigroup analyses
parts:
On 03/30/2015 08:59 PM, Mark Manning wrote:
> Hello,
>
> It has been my understanding that you ought to get an RMR/SRMR for each
> group in a multi-group analysis; however, I only get one when I estimate
> a multigroup model using lavaan.

True. But you can do this easily by hand: just use the code in

https://github.com/yrosseel/lavaan/blob/master/R/lav_fit_measures.R

around the lines 750--833 and you will have the SRMS for each group at
this point.

Yves.
